review_evidence: README states the goal is to formalize the mathematics of BLAS using Nat and real/complex mathematical types rather than bit-level behavior.
LeanBLAS/BLAS.lean defines BLAS and LawfulBLAS interfaces; other modules define complex scalar operations and specifications, with roughly 110 declaration-shaped items in 19 Lean files.
The two Test/ Lean files directly exercise the level-one/level-two CBLAS binding/specification boundary; no independent generated or documentation-only source set is present.
summary: Retain LeanBLAS completely: the repository is explicitly a formal mathematical specification of BLAS and its small test surface exercises those specifications rather than duplicating generated material.
